traits.note: Watson and Dallwitz, The Families of Flowering Plants (DELTA data, items edited May 2026), family Velloziaceae: leaves alternate; leaves simple; margins entire or dentate; veins parallel; blades linear; leaf rosettes basal or terminal; plants hermaphrodite; ovary inferior; stems herbaceous; flowers actinomorphic; perianth tepals; fruit capsule; parts of each whorl 3; stamens 6 to 66; carpels 3. Read from the coded states by script (spec-rework/b1/delta/mapdelta.py); a state the authors qualify (rarely, usually, a share) keeps its word, an unqualified one beside a usual state reads as sometimes.

traits.inflorescence.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 110, 111, family Velloziaceae: inflorescence solitary (or few flowers, terminal), often; read as {"solitary": "often"}.

traits.flowering_position.note: Ronse De Craene, Floral Diagrams (2010) p. 110, 111, family Velloziaceae: flowering position terminal; read as "terminal".
